title: Check yourself: Long sessions: windows, stale facts, late updates, isolation and the practice

questions.stem: Scenario S1, customer support resolution agent. At turn twelve a customer says the delivery address has changed. A delayed copy of the customer's turn-two message, which holds the old address, is processed afterwards. What should the facts store hold?

options.text: The old address, because it was the last one processed
options.says: Ruled out because "Order of arrival does not decide".

options.text: The updated value as current, with the earlier one in the history
options.says: The date decides, so the late older value goes to the history and the current value is untouched.

options.text: Both addresses as current values until the customer confirms one
options.says: Ruled out because "a value with an earlier date is recorded in the history and does not replace anything", so nothing is left unsettled.

options.text: The new address, with the old one deleted so that no trace remains
options.says: Ruled out because "The old value is kept in the history, since an audit or a dispute may ask what was known when".

questions.stem: Scenario S1, customer support resolution agent. One agent process serves many customers. After a deploy, customers see another customer's order details. The engineers find that the facts store was keyed by an id that the model copied from the conversation. What should they change?

options.text: Add a prompt rule telling the model to leave other people's data out of its replies
options.says: Ruled out because "A rule written in the prompt is not isolation".

options.text: Empty the store hourly so that stale entries cannot be reached by anyone
options.says: Ruled out because the leak comes from the key, and the page's remedy is "Everything that is cached, remembered or summarised is scoped the same way", not a periodic clearing.

options.text: Add the customer's name to each fact so that the model can tell them apart
options.says: Ruled out because facts of other customers are "excluded where the text is assembled, not left for the model to ignore".

options.text: Take the key from the authenticated session and filter where the context is built
options.says: The identity comes from the session the application holds, and the exclusion happens in code before the model sees anything.
